# WindowMode

[Desktop](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Desktop` · enum

```csharp
public enum WindowMode
```

The state the window is in. Each state excludes the others, so one value says it all.

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| <a name="windowed"></a>`Windowed` | A window with a title bar, at the size the game or the player gave it. The default. |
| <a name="maximized"></a>`Maximized` | A window with a title bar, filling the screen's usable area. |
| <a name="fullscreen"></a>`FullScreen` | Covering the whole screen with no title bar, without changing the display's resolution. |
